purpose: Own one governed evolution transaction for incident-driven repair, opportunity/capability-gap discovery and evaluated-knowledge improvement. Prevent discovery, evaluation, promotion, execution and observation from becoming disconnected helper-local steps.

origin_kinds.INCIDENT: A detected failure class or recurring problem may originate evolution after evidence-traced cognition.
origin_kinds.CAPABILITY_GAP: A newly discovered latent capability gap may originate evolution without fabricating an incident. It must be traceable to admitted outside-in discovery and raw evidence.
origin_kinds.EVALUATED_KNOWLEDGE: Evaluated or canonical knowledge may originate evolution without fabricating a failure, but must satisfy the same proposal/evaluation/promotion/observation transaction.

height_breadth_depth_admission.height: Every material evolution transaction names the governing outcome; the current task is not assumed to be the final objective.
height_breadth_depth_admission.breadth: Broad capability-gap discovery uses multiple outside-in lenses and cannot be only a known-keyword search or literal role-play.
depth: bind the transaction to raw evidence rather than only digested summaries
identify professional methods/tools that materially change evaluation
for proactive capability-gap evolution include novelty/unknown-signal probes
bind evaluation to an external or independent judge/eval path rather than same-model confidence
stretch targets are search constraints only and require feasibility evidence; model insistence is not feasibility proof

transaction_invariants: Exactly one transaction owns a proposal from admitted origin through post-promotion observation.
Stages cannot be skipped by directly mutating ProposalState.
Capability gaps are first-class proposal origins via capability_gap_ids rather than being misclassified as failure classes.
A proposal must retain evidence linkage to its admitted origin/discovery.
Evaluation must include evidence from at least one declared external/independent judge.
Promotion authorization still uses complexity, scenario coverage, regression and owner/action-authority gates.
Promotion and rollback execution evidence are persisted in the same transaction.
Post-promotion observation determines keep/observe, rollback or retirement; promotion is not closure.

proactive_evolution.periodic_review_principle: A capable host should run periodic capability review even when no incident exists; cadence is host-owned and risk/velocity aware rather than hard-coded into the kernel.
proactive_evolution.handoff_rule: An admitted CapabilityDiscoveryReceipt does not terminate the work. If a latent gap is worth changing, it must enter EvolutionTransaction as CAPABILITY_GAP and continue through evaluation and governed promotion or receive an explicit evidence-backed no-change/reject disposition.
proactive_evolution.mutation_rule: Periodic discovery is read-only by default. Production changes remain candidate branch -> PR -> owner-appropriate checks -> controlled merge/update -> production reread.

compatibility.rule: Helpers remain reusable mechanisms and compatibility surfaces; they no longer own an independent end-to-end evolution lifecycle.

external_method_basis: NIST AI RMF: ongoing monitoring and periodic review
ISO/IEC 42001: continual improvement of AI management systems
User-provided Felix Rieseberg height/breadth/depth method used as a candidate operational lens, with stretch-target feasibility bounded by evidence
assurance_boundary: Repository-controlled runtimes can mechanically enforce this transaction where they invoke it. Native ChatGPT response/tool paths still have no verified repository-controlled pre-send or pre-tool hook; host adapters must not claim non-bypassable enforcement without evidence.
